title: Trump Reverses Course on Taxpayer-Funded Self-Promotional Advertising
detail: President Trump announced he will stop using taxpayer funds for self-promotional advertising following public backlash — a rare reversal for the administration, coming during his active midterm campaign push.

title: Becton Dickinson Pledges $19 Billion in U.S. Investment in Exchange for Tariff Relief
detail: Medical device company Becton Dickinson pledged $19 billion in U.S. investment after striking a deal with the Trump administration to soften trade-war tariff exposure, the latest firm to negotiate bespoke relief amid the ongoing trade war.

title: Trump Awards $6.6 Billion Defense Shipyard Contract to Top Republican Donor's Firm
detail: President Trump announced a $6.6 billion defense shipyard contract awarded to a firm owned by a top Republican donor, raising conflict-of-interest concerns. The deal involves a Baltimore-area shipyard and the defense technology company Anduril, whose owner has been a significant contributor to Republican causes.

media.caption: Trump awards $6.6 billion shipyard contract to Republican donor's firm

title: US Defense Firm Gets $2.9 Billion Submarine Contract After CEO Joins Pentagon War Study with Musk
detail: A US defense firm received a $2.9 billion submarine contract shortly after its chief executive participated in a Pentagon war study alongside Elon Musk. The timing raised questions about the role of Musk's influence and proximity to defense contracting decisions under the Trump administration.

media.caption: US defense firm secures $2.9B submarine contract after CEO joined Pentagon war study with Elon Musk
